title: Coast Guard Medevacs Man from Fishing Boat
description: B-roll of a man being rescued by members of the Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City. Scenes include an aerial shot of the fishing boat from the rescue helicopter, the helicopter crew and the man being taken into Atlantic General Hospital in Berlin, Md. The Coast Guard medevaced a 61-year-old man from a fishing boat 60 miles east of Ocean City Monday. The Coast Guard received a call at 2:15 p.m. from a crew member aboard the Emily Brook reporting a crewman was experiencing shortness of breath due to asthma and needed medical assistance.A rescue helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City, N.J., arrived on scene and hoisted the man aboard their helicopter.The man was transported to Atlantic General Hospital in Berlin, Md., for treatment.
keywords: Atlantic City, rescue at sea, Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City
